svg.title: Proa, Marko and React streaming the product grid through Suspense over HTTP

svg.text: One core per engine · 96 cards · 8 boundaries · medians of 3 server processes
Higher is better · dashed: request-rate target
Latency starts at scheduled arrival and includes queueing.
